broader_coverage.reasoning: The closest prior square-exclusion assertion covers numbers with only one or two prime factors, and only the distinct f(n) function has a general nonsquare theorem. The present claim treats every n, including arbitrary repeated factors; the known nearby theorems do not logically imply it.
